purpose: Minimum visual validation of the 2x2 modular battlefield relationship. This is a review board, not a Unity-ready atlas or a single runtime texture.
validated_relationships: four equal walkable tiles meet at one clean central grid intersection
the regular tactical grid reads as stone seams
front, left and right platform faces share one oblique perspective
one environment prop is anchored to a tile and casts a local shadow
rear wall and low-detail background establish depth without entering the play area
next_step: After direction approval, extract separate native 32x32 surface, 32x40 front/left/right edge pieces, wall modules and the already-approved planter prop.
